summaryByAgendaItem.summary: The team discussed their fintech middleware project that connects merchants with banks to enable collateral-free loans. The system utilizes psychological questions, external payment accounts like eSewa and electricity bills, and a community vouching mechanism to generate credit scores. An offline, locally hosted LLM summarizes applicant details for bank managers, while an ML model trained on synthetic and real data performs fraud detection and cluster analysis without making automatic approval decisions.
Pawan was acknowledged as the team leader guiding the overall vision, while Samrat was recognized as the technical lead responsible for turning plans into working code and architecture.

The team outlined their hackathon timeline: conducting separate individual research for the first three hours starting Friday, synthesizing ideas into an agreed plan, building the MVP during the initial sprint, and allocating substantial time to presentation and question preparation. They also decided to actively consult mentors from the first day to identify flaws early and defend their core concept.
